Anna L: Quick design question — the trace panel export button currently says 'Export'. For error analytics flows I think we should change label to 'Export traces' and surface format (CSV / JSON) in a small dropdown. Thoughts? cc @Devin R Devin R: +1 to explicit label. Also: when export modal opens focus should go to the format selector for keyboard users. Right now focus lands on the close X which is confusing. Micah P: Also +1 on label. One more thing: the stack trace 'Copy' action currently copies HTML when using the viewer — we should ensure it copies plain text by default. Support often pastes into tickets and the HTML breaks formatting. Liz C: UX note — prefer 'Trace ID' as the visible label (not 'Correlation ID'). Add a tooltip: 'Unique identifier for this request/trace'. Keep tooltip short. Anna L: Ok so: (1) change button to 'Export traces' (2) show format dropdown in modal with initial focus (3) change copy button to 'Copy stack trace' and copy plain text. Anything else? @a11y-bot any accessibility nits? :eyes: a11y-bot: Recommend aria-live="polite" announcement on export completion and role="status" for the toast. Modal should trap focus and return focus to the export button after close. Dropdown needs aria-label and keyboard support (arrow navigation). Ensure tooltip is accessible (aria-describedby). Devin R: Example for the announcement (can paste into modal success handler): ```html
Export complete — 42 traces. Download
``` Micah P: For the backend export endpoint let's make sure content-disposition is set for downloads. Example request we use for testing: `POST /api/traces/export { "format": "json", "filter": "error:true", "limit": 50 }` Anna L: Small copy tweak for the modal header: instead of 'Export' use 'Export traces & spans' or just 'Export traces (JSON/CSV)'. Which is clearer? Liz C: I vote 'Export traces' and then show format next to it. Adding '(JSON / CSV)' in header feels noisy. Keep header short, add format selector visible. Devin R: Layout question — should Export be in overflow (•••) or on the main toolbar? Support uses it a lot so leaving it buried increases friction. Maybe move it next to 'Share' with icon + text. Anna L: Good point. Could be primary toolbar but with a small chevron for last-used format. e.g., [Export traces ▾] with a small pill saying 'JSON' if JSON was last used. Micah P: If we surface last-used format, ensure color contrast of that pill meets WCAG. Also make the pill keyboard-focusable and announce via SR when it changes. a11y-bot: Contrast: interactive elements should meet 3:1 for UI components and 4.5:1 for text. Verify color tokens. Provide visible focus ring for the pill and chevron. Anna L: Copy decision: 'Copy stack trace' on the button. Export success text: 'Export complete — X traces exported. Download' (link). For canned support flows maybe add 'View in logs' link too. Devin R: Runtime note for 'Copy stack trace' — I'll change the client to call `getPlainStack()` instead of innerText from the DOM. Handles source maps too. Assigning to @Micah for server header tweak. Micah P: Got it, I'll open a PR to set content-disposition and add a small sanitize step for copied stacks (strip zero-width chars). ETA tomorrow. Anna L: I'll update the Figma: new toolbar placement + export modal wire + copy label. Then I will add the tooltip copy and accessible flow. Liz C: Leave a short comment in the doc about language: avoid 'correlation' — users search for 'trace id'. Anna L: Next steps: Anna — update Figma & copy; Devin — modal focus & aria-live; Micah — copy & headers; Liz — final copy review; a11y-bot — verify ARIA rules once implemented. Target: EOD Wed for initial PRs. :+1: Devin R: One tiny test to add — keyboard only: open modal, change format, press Enter, confirm toast announced and focus returns to export button. Anna L: Thanks all — I'll create tasks in the trace-ux board and link PRs. Micah P: FYI log snippet I saw during export failures: `ERROR: export job failed: write /tmp/export-1234: permission denied` — we'll add better error text in modal too ("Export failed — try again or contact support"). Anna L: Good call — include that error copy in the modal error state. Liz C: :+1: Anna L: Closing convo here — will post updates when PRs are opened. Thanks!
